title: View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF does not block any add/edit/delete area
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF, See Financial Data ON, Invoicing & payments View/Create & Edit/Delete, and Part sales View/Create & Edit/Delete.
custom_steps:
1. Check that Invoicing & payments works.
  2. Check that Part sales works.
custom_expected:
No add/edit/delete area is blocked by AP/AR being off.

Only the AP/AR-specific views are hidden.
evidence: UI: AP/AR Data OFF does not block any add/edit/delete — Service Advisor (AP/AR off) still opens the editable Edit Customer modal and retains full customer/WO/parts create-edit; only the financial tabs/fields are hidden.
